claims: Mariners.TV covers WA, OR, ID, MT, AK, and HI.
In-market Seattle Mariners games for the 2026 season are available via Mariners.TV streaming service.
In-market Seattle Mariners games for the 2026 season are available through cable/satellite providers Xfinity 1261, DirecTV 687, Spectrum 414.
Nationally broadcast Seattle Mariners games are on Apple TV+, FOX, or Peacock.
Nationally broadcast Seattle Mariners games require separate subscriptions.
